motions.item_title: Committee of the Whole Consent Report
motions.text: That the March 26, 2024 Committee of the Whole Consent Report and Council Consent report identified below be adopted.
motions.text_html: That the March 26, 2024 Committee of the Whole Consent Report and Council Consent report identified below be adopted.

motions.text: That the 2024 City of Guelph property tax ratios and corresponding tax rates, as set out in Attachment-1 to the report 2024-63 titled 2024 Property Tax Policy dated March 5, 2024, be approved.
motions.text_html: 1. That the 2024 City of Guelph property tax ratios and corresponding tax rates, as set out in Attachment-1 to the report 2024-63 titled 2024 Property Tax Policy dated March 5, 2024, be approved.

motions.text: That the report titled ‘Internal Audit Work Plan 2024–2026’ dated March 5, 2024, be approved. That the Internal Audit Charter Update dated March 5, 2024, be received. That the Value-for-Money Audit Review Framework be approved.
motions.text_html:
1. That the report titled ‘Internal Audit Work Plan 2024–2026’ dated March 5, 2024, be approved.
  2. That the Internal Audit Charter Update dated March 5, 2024, be received.
  3. That the Value-for-Money Audit Review Framework be approved.

motions.text: That Council waive any applicable Parkland Dedication fees for the Emergency Shelter renovation and expansion planned for 23 Gordon Street
motions.text_html: 1. That Council waive any applicable Parkland Dedication fees for the Emergency Shelter renovation and expansion planned for 23 Gordon Street

motions.item_title: City of Hamilton Resolution: Support for the Decision of the Ontario Energy Board to End the Gas Pipeline Subsidy
motions.text: That the City of Guelph expresses its support for the decision of the Ontario Energy Board to end the fossil gas infrastructure subsidy and requests that the Ontario Government withdraw Bill 165 and allow the OEB decision to stand; and That this resolution be circulated to the President of Association of Municipalities of Ontario, Colin Best; Premier of Ontario, Doug Ford; Minister of Energy, Todd Smith; Minister of Finance, Peter Bethlenfalvy, MPP Mike Schreiner, and all Ontario Municipalities requesting support for the proposed changes.
motions.text_html:
1. That the City of Guelph expresses its support for the decision of the Ontario Energy Board to end the fossil gas infrastructure subsidy and requests that the Ontario Government withdraw Bill 165 and allow the OEB decision to stand; and
  2. That this resolution be circulated to the President of Association of Municipalities of Ontario, Colin Best; Premier of Ontario, Doug Ford; Minister of Energy, Todd Smith; Minister of Finance, Peter Bethlenfalvy, MPP Mike Schreiner, and all Ontario Municipalities requesting support for the proposed changes.

motions.text: That the minutes of the open Council Meetings held February 7, 13, 14, and 21, 2024, the Committee of the Whole meeting held February 6, 2024, be confirmed as recorded and without being read.
motions.text_html: That the minutes of the open Council Meetings held February 7, 13, 14, and 21, 2024, the Committee of the Whole meeting held February 6, 2024, be confirmed as recorded and without being read.

motions.text: That by-laws (2024) - 20902 through (2024) - 20906 and (2024) - 20930 be approved subject to Section 284.11 (4) of the Municipal Act.
motions.text_html: 1. That by-laws (2024) - 20902 through (2024) - 20906 and (2024) - 20930 be approved subject to Section 284.11 (4) of the Municipal Act.
